name: 道の駅 おおとう桜街道
desc: 福岡県大任町にある道の駅「おおとう桜街道」は、西日本最大級の規模を誇る大人気のスポットです。最大の特徴は、優雅な陶器が飾られた通称「1億円トイレ」や、天然温泉、子ども向けの遊具施設が併設されており、家族連れで一日中楽しめる点にあります。特産品は「しじみ」と「にんにく」。直売所には毎朝採れたての新鮮な野菜が並ぶほか、黒にんにくを使った万能ダレや、名物「しじみソフトクリーム」なども堪能できます。
descEn: Located in Oto Town, Fukuoka Prefecture, Roadside Station "Oto Sakura Kaido" is a highly popular destination and one of the largest in Western Japan. Its most unique feature is the luxurious "100-million-yen toilet" adorned with elegant ceramics, making it possible for families to enjoy a full day with other facilities like a natural hot spring and a children's play area. The area's specialties are "shijimi" (freshwater clams) and garlic. In addition to freshly picked vegetables filling the farmers' market each morning, visitors can savor items like a versatile sauce made with black garlic and the famous "shijimi soft-serve ice cream.
